Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 14th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Tech in Signal Processing/Communication Systems or equivalent, or a B.Tech in ECE or Electrical Engineering. A valid GATE/CSIR-UGC NET qualification is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit. For detailed information on age criteria and any potential relaxations, please refer to the official advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an online interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: You need to submit a detailed CV, experience certificates, and scanned copies of all UG & PG degree certificates and marksheets.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is to be done via email. You need to send your application along with the required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based position, meaning it is likely for the duration of the specific research project for which the recruitment is being made.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SRIC/06.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.
